Boss states persist; the intro-done flag is not written by WriteSaveDataMore, so a reload before the kill would need the orb again.

unresolved.evidence_gap: Nefarian 41376 (12.75) and Onyxia 41270 (10.34375) 10N staged from WCL U samples; Animated Bone Warrior 41918 (Empower stacks) and the 25N/10H/25H templates 51104-51106, 51116-51118 stay at DamageModifier 1.

Breath: WCL shows 3 ticks (native 1; SpellMgr patch requested). Nefarian phase 1 Tail Lash (native every 5 s) is unobserved: phase 1 lasted under 15 s in all three kills. Phase 3 Tail Lash repeats 11.3-21.0 s vs native 15-22 s; cones 90 natively vs 60 in 4.4.2 (not observable in WCL).
Native 3 s period and +17; client 1 s period; guides +25 and +1 per 2 s. WCL has no Electrical Charge series (resources pane, MxFq7 fight 35).
Cadence resolved by WCL: Blast Nova 13 s (native correct), Barrage 3.2 s (native repaired from 2.5 s on 10N only; other modes keep 2.5 s). Open: Barrage targets per cast (native cap 4 vs Wowhead 10).
Schedule confirmed by WCL (30/25/20/15/15 s in two kills). Spread direction (controller-stalker based) unverified.
Count resolved: 4 in 10N (WCL, two kills). Lifetime: native 33 s energy vs Wowhead 50 s; WCL phase 3 lifetimes 44-70 s include refills.

The user expects the phase 1 Onyxia burn may not hold on heroic or with lower gear; heroic keeps the Electrocute budget untested, and heroic magma (+2000 per 81118 stack) makes the 8.4 s swim cost about 96k per bot.
Dominion cap 5/2 vs legacy 1/5; Cinders cadence 15 s native vs 22-25 s DBM; heroic phase 3 after one prototype (BigWigs) vs all three (Journal).
